misprints.note: Turned type: 'ugn' printed clearly, kept as printed.
The genitive ending appears to carry a breathing under the circumflex. Kept as ἦρος.
An accented ἔκ before an enclitic, as printed. Probably not an error; noted for review.

uncertain.note: There is a small mark under the circumflex on η, read as a smooth breathing. It could be only part of the circumflex, which would give ῆρος.
No breathing is visible under the circumflex, so I kept ῆτος.
The column ends with 'aflägse' and no hyphen, and the next page continues 'fr. ngt'. I read it as the complete word aflägse, so there is no hyphen and no tilde.
